about: The balloon transport system (travel networks step T5): Auguste on Entrana and the assistants at the other five stations, each the multi-NPC live spawns (it shows the assistant once the station is open, which every account has). Tiles from mejrs's live NPC list; none wanders (guessed). The Grand Tree has two: Assistant Le Smith and Assistant Lori, each shown by its own varbit.
